title: European Union: Erasmus+ Mobility Programme for Higher Education Students
summary: Erasmus+ mobility supports study periods and traineeships in specified programme and partner countries for eligible higher education students.

degree_levels.notes: Covers Bachelor's, Master's, doctoral students, and comprehensive degree courses such as medicine or traditional diploma courses.

institutions.notes: Enrolled at a higher education institution participating in the Erasmus+ project AND whose home institution has signed an Erasmus cooperation agreement with the receiving institution.

nationality.notes: Students are either nationals of a country participating in the Erasmus+ programme, or nationals of other countries enrolled in a regular degree course at an institution of higher education in a participating country.

residence.notes: Residing in a participating country/origin country as stipulated by regulations.

mandatory.text: Regularly enrolled at a higher education institution
Enrolled at a higher education institution participating in the Erasmus+ project and home institution has signed an Erasmus cooperation agreement with receiving institution
Students are at least in the second year of their degree course (not applicable to Master's students) before applying for a study visit (may apply for internship in first year)

exceptions.text: Master's students are not restricted by the second-year requirement.
Internship applications are allowed in the first year of study.

funding.description: The grant value varies depending on destination and higher education institution. Sponsored students are exempt from tuition, registration, examination, laboratory and library fees at the host institution.
funding.duration: 2 to 12 months (maximum 36 months for studies or traineeships: up to 12 months for Bachelor's, Master's, or doctoral students; up to 24 months for comprehensive degree courses like medicine/state exam/diploma, with an additional 12 months for doctoral students)

application_rounds.notes: Please contact the International Office of your home institution for further information on the application deadlines.

steps.text: Contact the Erasmus+ coordinators at the International Office of your home institution.

sources.title: European Union: Erasmus+ Mobility Programme for Higher Education Students - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: In scope because international higher education students can receive funding for study and traineeship mobility periods including physical stays in Germany.
